interpretation_limits: This is a synthetic task and unequal RAW/INV/REL model packages (502/406/340 parameters; same six recurrent state scalars), with executed FLOPs and peak memory not measured. It is not Gate 1 evidence or an isolated topology effect. The replay shares frozen forward, generator and intervention implementations, although it independently checks stored data XOR, metric reductions and intervention invariants; it is not an independent implementation or retraining replication. NORM_SHAM can be unreachable for some examples (up to 5.57% among four new seeds); ANGLE_SHAM has materially different displacement and is not an equal-amplitude control. Immediate readout sensitivity does not establish training causality, stable semantic specialization or autonomous correction. The later NORM effect cannot replace the preregistered immediate crossover endpoint. The old seed and t-intervals are descriptive, not confirmation units.
